lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: We should keep moving. East. The Depot's that way. Everything's east of something.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: And every dark lamp you light is one less for the Foreman to count. Costs minutes, though.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The Depot's past Main Street. Keep going east.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: In a fight, Help is slow but you make a friend. Hustle is fast but... you don't.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: You helped the Un-Baker count. Nobody helps the Un-Baker count.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The front door's for workers with cards. We use the side door. I know a trick.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Curfew's on the square. Through the big door on the right.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The square's through the big door.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: And don't wind anything you find in the lost-and-found! I mean it!

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: That watch. In a fight, if something's about to hit you, press {rewind}. Don't ask me how I know.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Curfew's slow. Watch the notes when it sings. They fall in an order.
